method: 12 scenarios. Exact TypingHistory class extracted into audit-only Swift test; only class/store identifiers renamed and file persistence replaced with an in-memory store. Actual PersonalHistory and PersonalLexicon used. No UIKit/device events; host callbacks modeled explicitly. Production source SHA256 recorded below.

findings.evidence: observe dün akşam + 1,2,3 spaces yields akşam count 3 and dün→akşam pair count 3, despite one word occurrence. Identical duplicate callback control remains count 1.
findings.cause: Dedup identity includes before.count, so extra whitespace creates a new observation.

findings.evidence: Same TypingHistory instance sees merhaba-space, empty field, m, me, merhaba, merhaba-space; count remains 1. refreshImports at empty field does not reset dedup.
findings.cause: Empty/incomplete observations return without invalidating lastObserved; no field identity is used.
findings.limitation: Applies when the same keyboard/history instance survives the field change; no claim all applications retain it.

findings.evidence: Live callbacks for dün akşam\n and dün akşam\nbugün-space learn akşam→bugün. Bulk observe of the identical multiline text does not.
findings.cause: TypingHistory tokenizes the whole before string and takes last two tokens; PersonalHistory.observe(text:) resets predecessor per line.

findings.evidence: PersonalLexicon.ingest of qrmenü in chunks [1,1,1] yields 1 point; [2,1] yields 2; one [3] batch admits at 3. Repeating [3,3] stays 3 as designed.
findings.cause: ingest uses max(existingPoints, chunkCount) to support repeat-import idempotence; InputCoordinator comment promises split imports accumulate but this is not implemented.
findings.limitation: This is personal dictionary ingest (learn from field), not the WhatsApp PersonalHistory import path. Deduplication versus distinct batches needs an explicit design choice.

code_review_followups.evidence: KeyboardSettingsPanel only creates delete rows for personalWords.prefix(30); remainder is a UILabel. LearningView searches the whole list but has no delete action.
code_review_followups.limitation: Source-level reachability finding, not yet reproduced in a populated simulator UI.

controls: Erase/retype with an intervening committed token counted twice.
Single three-occurrence personal import admits; repeated identical batch does not inflate score.
reproduce: python3 audits/generate_history_audit.py; KB_HISTORY_AUDIT=/absolute/report.json swift test --package-path Packages/KeyboardCore --filter HistoryLifecycleAuditTests
